scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents
papers.authors: Haochen Zhao, Minsheng Hao, Zheng Li, Yifan Li, Zikang Liu, Bowen Qin, Yuhao Cheng, Chuang Fan, Haosheng Zou, Jeff Chen, Sujian Li
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.17827v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. We introduce CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models to provide targeted supervision following t
papers.summary: 搜索智能体的引用正确，并不代表多个来源相互独立或冲突已经解决。CSEG 用六层决策树评价完整轨迹，构建覆盖九类路径的 1,160 条核实样本；奖励模型路径精确率达 83.9%，以其监督冻结检索的回答策略后，独立评判均值从 2.83 升至 4.19。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子、转载和评论常共享同一消息源，引用数量容易夸大证据强度。可借鉴其层级标注，将来源独立性、冲突归因和裁决纳入搜索回答质量评估，再用于训练奖励模型；先固定召回结果比较回答策略，避免把检索变化误归因为证据推理提升。

papers.title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
papers.authors: M. Yigit Turali, Shreyas Rajesh, M. Efe Lorasdagi, Chenda Duan, Kartik Sharma, Vwani Roychowdhury
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15208v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seve
papers.summary: PANINI-DR 将总体协调与子问题研究、证据核查分离，用共享语义工作区记录依赖关系、结论和来源。研究在固定语料和相同骨干下对比七套框架，在 BrowseComp-Plus 达到 73.3% 准确率，领先次优框架 16.0 个百分点，并检查保存证据能否重建答案。
papers.key_insight: 多跳社区搜索可以把已确认事实与待解决问题写入持久工作区，在后续查询复用前逐条核验证据。关键收益来自状态结构和核查闭环，不能只归功于增加智能体数量；建议同时统计答案正确率、证据可恢复性与单位任务成本，并在固定语料上先验证。

papers.title: Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support
papers.authors: Istok Bako, Bonan Min, Tiffany Shao, Claire Cheng, Yashar Mehdad
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14428v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agent
papers.summary: 论文以客服流程生成展示轻量 Agentic RAG：自然语言技能、检索与格式检查工具，加上 LLM 生成的类维基导航层。实现约需 1—2 个工程日，流程等价率达 99.2%，证据充分率为 83.3%；单例约 90 秒，明显慢于生产助手的 8—9 秒。
papers.key_insight: 对于规则清晰且文档经过整理的社区客服或运营检索，可先试验导航索引与可编辑技能，降低复杂检索栈的维护成本。流程正确和证据充分需要分开验收；论文场景每例都有人审，且容忍较高延迟，因此不宜直接外推到毫秒级社区搜索主链路。

papers.title: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
papers.authors: Cong Pang, Jiaqi Su, Chengrui Wu, Kuihao Yan, Tianrui Zhang, Zixuan Qiu, Chao Lin, Zixiu Lin, Zixuan Chen, Zelin Xiao, Tiankuo Yao, Jiawei Hong, Zixuan Chen, Dan Xu, Lewei Lu, Wenjie Wang, Xin Lou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.16998v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep search enables language agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks through iterative web exploration. However, developing robust open-source agents remains challenging for three reasons. First, opaque trajectory-construction pipelines make training data difficult to audit and reproduce. Second, context compression can create a substantial mismatch between training and inference. Third, agents may retrieve benchmark content from the open web during evaluation, contaminating the results and overstating their performance. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce Glasseek, a fully transparent deep search framework spanning the complete development lifecycle, releasing all data, model weights, training recipes, and code. Specifically, for data construction, we establish a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline that systematically generates high-quality exploration paths. For training, we propose Compaction-Managed GSPO (CM-GSP
papers.summary: Glasseek 公开深搜数据、模型和训练代码，以 CM-GSPO 对齐搜索与上下文压缩，并提供防基准泄漏组件。9B 模型在 BrowseComp 达 61.6%、Seal-0 达 50.0%；审计中 Agents-A1 加防泄漏后从 63.4% 降至 58.3%，说明公开网页答案会抬高评测。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索智能体训练应同时保存查询、工具结果和压缩边界，并让训练与线上摘要机制保持一致。离线评测要过滤题库及历史答案页，区分原论文引用结果与统一环境复测结果；该模型在部分基准领先，仍不能据此宣称全面超过所有闭源系统。

papers.title: LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity
papers.authors: Yibo Wang, Senjie Jin, Yansong Ning, Xinbing Liang, Haotian Luo, Jiazheng Zhang, Yuxuan He, Will Wu,  Clarenceai
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18092v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep research (DR) agents address open-ended information needs through multi-step reasoning, long-horizon web search, and evidence synthesis. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on academic research or synthetic tasks, leaving DR agents' capabilities in real-world life and professional productivity settings insufficiently evaluated. To bridge this gap, we introduce LifeSearch, a challenging benchmark comprising 203 Chinese and English tasks derived from real-user query seeds across 7 concrete life and productivity domains. With more than 4,500 hours of human annotation, we construct over 4,000 expert-written, fine-grained rubrics, covering both report-content criteria for coverage and accuracy and concrete criteria specifying values, units, dates, and URLs. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 advanced DR agents under a unified evaluation harness, systematically analyzing their performance patterns and failure modes. We find t
papers.summary: LifeSearch 覆盖生活与工作场景的中英双语深度研究，共 203 个任务、七个领域，投入超过 4,500 小时标注并制定逾 4,000 条细粒度规则。统一评测 12 个智能体，最优得分仅 63.4%；总分与人类排序的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.89。
papers.key_insight: 社区用户的复杂搜索更接近生活决策，而非单一事实问答。可把报告覆盖、准确性与具体数值、单位、日期、链接拆成独立规则，并用人工标签校准裁判；63.4% 是该基准评分，不能当作线上搜索满意度或点击率，仍需真实用户行为验证。

papers.title: Avoiding What Your Teacher Already Knows: Entity Familiarity for Deep-Search Distillation
papers.authors: Yifei Liu, Zhixiang Liang, Wentao Tan, Yicheng Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Nan Duan, Qiong Cao
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.16251v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep-search agents are commonly trained by distilling tool-use trajectories from stronger teacher models. However, structurally complex questions may remain relatively easy for teachers familiar with key entities in the underlying entity graph, resulting in lower search demand and weaker supervision. We refer to this teacher-specific variation in question difficulty as teacher-relative difficulty and investigate entity familiarity as an early predictor. We first introduce Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity (EVF), which estimates familiarity by verifying a teacher-generated factual brief against online evidence. Across multiple teachers, EVF is significantly correlated with teacher-relative difficulty with AUCs of 0.60--0.70. However, its high cost makes it impractical for constructing entity graphs at scale. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Reported Entity Familiarity (SEF), a lightweight gating signal that directly asks a t
papers.summary: 论文指出教师熟悉实体时会减少真实搜索，导致蒸馏轨迹监督不足。EVF 对教师相对难度的预测 AUC 为 0.60—0.70，低成本 SEF 则直接询问熟悉度；结合 5,411 条复用轨迹与 2,200 条新轨迹，27B 学生在 BrowseComp 子集从 44.10% 升至 66.41%。
papers.key_insight: 为社区长尾查询构造搜索训练集时，实体冷门程度应相对具体教师衡量，而非只看问题跳数。可用便宜的熟悉度门控提高轨迹的信息量，再抽样核验实际搜索需求；报告中的提升来自多种数据组合，不能归因于门控单项，也不能把子集成绩当成全量成绩。

papers.title: Optimizing Agent Reliability and Tool Calling Efficiency for Chip Design Using NVIDIA NeMo Gym
papers.abstract: AI agents offer remarkable productivity gains in complex chip design workflows, but their tendency to generate plausible yet incorrect artifacts makes...
papers.summary: NVIDIA 与 Siemens 用 NeMo Gym 验收芯片表征智能体的最终 Liberty 文件，并按失败轨迹修改技能和工具说明。约 25 次 rollout 后，复合验证分数由约 55% 升至 95%，轮次从 155 降到 53，输出从约 81K 降至 29K tokens；调试限定为两个单元、36 个工况角。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索工具链同样应验收最终答案及其证据，而非把工具调用成功当成任务成功。可借鉴覆盖、格式、准确和完整性门控，追踪失败后迭代工具 schema；这里是特定工程小样本开发基准，不能把约 66% 轮次下降直接预测为社区搜索成本收益。

papers.title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
papers.summary: Google Deep Review 将文档分段、预算分配、并行核查与全局证据综合组合成四阶段智能体验证流程。前身 PAT 在四个计算机会议试点服务超过 16,000 份自愿提交稿件，现扩展到设计文档和演示材料；文章未给出可比的统一准确率提升数字。
papers.key_insight: 可将长篇社区问答或知识库审阅拆成局部核查，再对跨段关系做全局一致性检查，把算力分配给高密度论证。16,000 份是使用规模而非有效性证明，公开试点也不同于随机对照；落地前应抽取真实争议帖子，独立测量错误检出、误报与审阅延迟。

papers.title: RIVO: Lightweight Adaptive Rerouting for Deep Research Agents
papers.authors: Mingchen Li, Jiatan Huang, Hong Yu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15910v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. Based on this view, we introduce RIVO, a lightweight plug-in framework for adaptive trajectory correction. The agent estimates its research state from lightweight signals and determin
papers.summary: RIVO 以轻量状态信号判断深搜轨迹是否需要改道，并用 0.6B 插件调整冻结主模型的 token logits。LiteResearcher-4B 在 BrowseCore 的成功率由原始 53.48% 升至 59.30%；移除改道预测器后降至 53.63%，移除 logit 干预后为 56.82%。
papers.key_insight: 社区多跳搜索容易重复检索或过早停止，RIVO 提供了学习何时改道与如何改道的分离设计。实践中应先记录证据充分性、搜索轮次和无效查询，再训练小型控制器；logit 干预要求可访问主模型解码分布，接入只有文本接口的托管模型时存在实际限制。

papers.title: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
papers.authors: Keru Chen, Sen Lin, Yingbin Liang, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Shaofeng Zou
papers.abstract: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choi
papers.summary: CoSIR 用贝叶斯评估器衡量消息带来的团队惊讶度下降，分别奖励提供证据、请求缺失信息和真正利用收到的信息。研究以 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B-it 自博弈训练，在七个未见协作任务上报告最高聚合成绩；摘要未披露具体提升幅度。
papers.key_insight: 多智能体搜索中的消息不应仅按长度或最终答对与否奖励，可借鉴其信息增益信号，检验成员是否共享独有证据以及下游是否使用。社区语料包含重复和矛盾信息，迁移时需额外校准独立性；目前核实的是三种学生和七项任务，尚无社区搜索线上收益证据。
